name: power-cells
description: Power gauge above the prompt: context tokens left, the 5-hour limit, and a weekly pacing plan that gives you a daily ration so the 7-day limit lasts to the last minute.

workdays.title: Work days
workdays.description: Days that get a bigger share of the weekly limit, comma separated (mon,tue,wed,thu,fri).

workWeight.title: Work day weight
workWeight.description: How many times bigger a work day's share is than an off day's (2 means a work day gets double).
